fact: On 27 April 2023 the DGI launched e-Hetraphone in Anosy and Androy, letting taxpayers with a tax ID and a Mvola, Orange Money or Airtel Money account pay taxes by mobile money.
title: Campagne ANJARA Hetrako - L'année 2023 démarre à ANOSY et ANDROY
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances
